Fields.Name: Call ID
Fields.Description: The attack, projectile or effect this item calls. Call ID Type picks which list it comes from.

Fields.Name: Particle Variation ID
Fields.Description: Which visual effect plays when the player uses this item. None keeps the default look.

Fields.Name: Weight (kg)
Fields.Description: How much this item adds to your Equip Load.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Price
Fields.Description: Probably does nothing. Only weapons and armor can be reinforced.

Fields.Name: Sell Value
Fields.Description: How many souls feeding this item to Kingseeker Frampt grants.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: The Behavior ID that runs when the player uses this item.

Fields.Name: Replacement Item ID
Fields.Description: The item the player gets when this one runs out. None gives nothing.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Where this item sits in menu lists. Lower values sort first.

Fields.Name: World Tendency ID
Fields.Description: Probably unused in Dark Souls. It drove World Tendency in Demon's Souls.

Fields.Name: Message Text ID
Fields.Description: The Yes/No question shown when the player uses this item. None asks nothing.

Fields.Name: Magic ID
Fields.Description: The spell tied to this item. Whether any item uses this is not established.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Which menu icon this item shows.

Fields.Name: Model ID
Fields.Description: Which 3D model the game draws for this item.

Fields.Name: Shop Level
Fields.Description: Unknown. How shops use levels is not established.

Fields.Name: Achievement ID
Fields.Description: The completion achievement this item counts toward. The exact list is not established.

Fields.Name: Sequential Achievement ID
Fields.Description: The achievement tied to this item. The exact list is not established.

Fields.Name: Humanity Consumption
Fields.Description: How much Humanity using this item spends.

Fields.Name: Dexterity over Start Value
Fields.Description: Unknown. Its effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Call ID Type
Fields.Description: Which list the call ID comes from: attacks, projectiles or effects.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: Which attacks this item counts as, for buffs that raise one kind. Set None when no buff needs it.

Fields.Name: Item Use Animation
Fields.Description: The animation that plays when the player uses this item.

Fields.Name: Interaction Menu Type
Fields.Description: Which menu opens when the player uses this item.

Fields.Name: Use Limit Category
Fields.Description: Which active effects can block this item. It stays usable while none match.

Fields.Name: Replace Category
Fields.Description: Extra rule for picking the call target. Its exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 0
Fields.Description: Whether characters with no covenant can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 1
Fields.Description: Whether Way of White members can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 2
Fields.Description: Whether Princess Guard members can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 3
Fields.Description: Whether Warrior of Sunlight members can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 4
Fields.Description: Whether Darkwraith members can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 5
Fields.Description: Whether Path of the Dragon members can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 6
Fields.Description: Whether Gravelord Servant members can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 7
Fields.Description: Whether Forest Hunter members can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 8
Fields.Description: Whether Blade of the Dark Moon members can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 9
Fields.Description: Whether Chaos Servant members can use this item.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 10
Fields.Description: Whether members of covenant 10 can use this item. No covenant uses this number.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 11
Fields.Description: Whether members of covenant 11 can use this item. No covenant uses this number.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 12
Fields.Description: Whether members of covenant 12 can use this item. No covenant uses this number.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 13
Fields.Description: Whether members of covenant 13 can use this item. No covenant uses this number.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 14
Fields.Description: Whether members of covenant 14 can use this item. No covenant uses this number.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 15
Fields.Description: Whether members of covenant 15 can use this item. No covenant uses this number.

Fields.Name: Enable as Host Player
Fields.Description: Whether the host can use this item.

Fields.Name: Enable as Gray Phantom
Fields.Description: Whether gray phantoms can use this item. Which phantoms count as gray is not established.

Fields.Name: Enable as White Phantom
Fields.Description: Whether summoned white phantoms can use this item.

Fields.Name: Enable as Black Phantom
Fields.Description: Whether invading black phantoms can use this item.

Fields.Name: Enable in Multiplayer
Fields.Description: Whether this item works during online multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Enable only in Multiplayer
Fields.Description: Whether this item works in competitive multiplayer. Its difference from Enable in Multiplayer is not established.

Fields.Name: Disable Offline
Fields.Description: Whether being offline blocks this item. Turn it on for items that need other players.

Fields.Name: Is Equippable
Fields.Description: Whether this item can sit in an equipment slot. If not, the player uses it from the menu.

Fields.Name: Is Consumed
Fields.Description: Whether using this item spends one from the stack.

Fields.Name: Is Automatically Equipped
Fields.Description: Whether picking this item up equips it at once.

Fields.Name: Is Guidance Item
Fields.Description: Whether this item is a placed item. Its exact effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Is Unique Item
Fields.Description: Whether the player can hold only one of this item.

Fields.Name: Can Drop
Fields.Description: Whether the player can leave this item on the ground.

Fields.Name: Can Deposit
Fields.Description: Whether the player can move this item into storage.

Fields.Name: Disable if Right Hand is Empty
Fields.Description: Whether this item needs a weapon in the right hand. Without one the game blocks its use.

Fields.Name: Is Travel Item
Fields.Description: Whether this item can drift to another player's world. Left behind online, it may grow into a Good Vagrant.

Fields.Name: Is Replenishable Item
Fields.Description: Whether resting at a bonfire refills this item. Turn it on for the Estus Flask.

Fields.Name: Is Restocked Item
Fields.Description: Unknown. It probably touches bonfire refills, but its difference from Is Replenishable Item is not established.

Fields.Name: Is Enhancement Source
Fields.Description: Whether using this item buffs the equipped weapon.

Fields.Name: Is Repairable Item
Fields.Description: Whether using this item repairs equipment.

Fields.Name: Is Drop Disabled in Multiplayer
Fields.Description: Whether drops of this item stay out of other players' worlds.

Fields.Name: Is Disabled in PvP Arena
Fields.Description: Blocks this item inside the PvP arena.

Fields.Name: Is Enabled only in PvP Arena
Fields.Description: Whether this item works only inside the PvP arena.

Fields.Name: Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the Vagrant this item may become. -1 spawns none, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Good Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the extra creature a Good Vagrant may bring. -1 drops nothing, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Evil Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the creature an Evil Vagrant may bring. -1 drops nothing, and 0 grants nothing.
